# Air Quality Advisor v0.2.12 — Clearer mold indication and calibration details

This release makes the room Mold Indicator easier to understand while leaving the underlying calculations unchanged.

## Compact mold gauge

Instead of the ambiguous `RH Ø 55% · n=2 · 🌡️ 17.1°C`, the gauge displays two clearly labeled lines:

- **Average humidity: 55% · 2 sensors** — this is room relative humidity averaged from the two usable RH sensors, **not** the mold calibration factor.
- **Estimated surface: 17.1°C** — estimated temperature of the room's coldest surface.

The same labels are localized into all 38 supported card languages (for example Greek: **Μέση υγρασία: 55% · 2 αισθητήρες** and **Εκτιμώμενη επιφάνεια: 17,1°C**).

## More details

A room now offers **More details** whenever it has a saved mold calibration factor, even if the room displays only three measurement tiles. Expand it to see:

- **Calibration factor**, formatted as a decimal (for example **2.37**, or **2,37** in Greek and German).
- **Indoor temperature**, the live reading used by the calculation.
- **Outdoor temperature**, the live reading from the pinned weather provider used by the calculation.

The backend preserves the exact floating-point factor without rounding. Display formatting uses at least two and up to six decimal places; the full value remains accessible in the factor tooltip. If a temperature is unavailable, the details show a dash instead of fabricating a value. The existing missing-input warnings remain visible.

## Compatibility and validation

This is a presentation/metadata update only. The Magnus dew-point formula, calibration factor computation, 70% mold-indication threshold, 65% averaged RH fallback, outdoor-weather blocking rules, room sensors, announcement schedules, and Announcement Hub integration are unchanged.

Install via **HACS → Air Quality Advisor → v0.2.12** and restart Home Assistant to load the updated Python and Lovelace card. Automated Python tests, frontend checks, 38-language translation audit, Hassfest and HACS validation must pass before automatic publication.
